description: Use this for the fare and ride time between two stations of the Enoden (Enoshima Electric Railway) between Fujisawa and Kamakura: Kamakura, Wadazuka, Yuigahama, Hase, Gokurakuji, Inamuragasaki, Shichirigahama, Kamakura-kokomae, Koshigoe, Enoshima, Shonan-kaigan-koen, Kugenuma, Yanagikoji, Ishigami and Fujisawa. Station names are matched loosely ("great buddha" finds Hase). Returns minutes, adult and child fare, stops and when the Noriorikun day pass pays off. Examples: "How much is the Enoden from Kamakura to Enoshima?" / "How long does the Enoden take from Hase to Kamakura-kokomae?"
